# DHgate

> > DHgate is a leading cross-border B2B and B2C ecommerce marketplace connecting global buyers with China suppliers for wholesale products across electronics, fashion, home goods, and more.

Founded by the DHGATE Group, DHgate.com operates as a wholesale marketplace serving buyers in North America, Latin America, and Europe. The platform facilitates bulk buying and online shopping from Chinese manufacturers and suppliers across thousands of product categories.
